question: Given three DNA molecules of the same length (A, B and C) and in the same solvent, but with different richness in terms of G + C content (A: 50%, B: 60%, and C: 75% ), How would your melting temperatures (Tm) be ?:

options.opb: Being in the same solvent, they would be the same in all three cases.
options.opc: The DNA molecule C would not belong to a thermophilic bacterium, given its lower Tm.
options.ope: You can not know with the information of the statement.
